requirements.description: Energy class C or better is preferred, so the accepted classes are A1, A2, A3, A4, B and C.
User prefers properties near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires at least 95 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface threshold. The four-person capacity is not converted into an area filter. Energy class, proximity to green spaces, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: surface_area >= 95, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine on latitude/longitude, green >= 74, and energy_class in A1-A4, B, C. Conditions are ordered strictest to softest (surface, location, green, energy class). Results are sorted by distance from the coordinate.
